author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager - LAP
job_description:
**Product Manager: LAP (MSME & Salaried)**
==========================================

**Location:** Bangalore

**Focusing:** Tier 3 & 4 towns of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu & Andhra Pradesh

**Role Overview**
-----------------

This role requires understanding of Micro & Small Enterprises in Teir 2/3 geographies, knowledge of their cash flow nuances, ability to design and scale innovative credit products tailored to that segments.

The ideal candidate will bridge on-ground insights (including competitive benchmarking) with product, credit, and technology to drive growth, improve customer experience, and unlock new revenue streams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Product Strategy & Development**

* Design customer-centric loan products based on local market needs and income patterns.
* Continuously innovate on product constructs (Technology, TAT, Tenure, Ticket size, Repayment models, Hybrid income assessment, Type of Security etc.).

### **2. Customer & Market Understanding**

* Spend significant time in the field to understand customer behavior, needs, and pain points.
* Build strong insights into MSME cash flows, salaried informal segments, and local business ecosystems.
* Translate ground-level insights into scalable product features and policies.

### **3. Financial Needs Analysis**

* Analyze customer financial requirements across lifecycle stages (working capital, expansion, personal needs).
* Develop frameworks for income assessment in low-documentation/alternate sources environments.
* Work closely with credit teams to refine underwriting models for these segments.

### **4. Cross-Sell & Revenue Enhancement**

* Identify and drive cross-sell opportunities (PL, Mobile, Vehicle Gold, Cards etc.).
* Design bundled offerings tailored to customer segments.
* Improve customer lifetime value (LTV) through product innovation.

### **5. Process Optimization (Lead to Disbursement)**

* Own end-to-end funnel: lead generation login approval disbursement.
* Identify bottlenecks and improve TAT, conversion rates, and customer experience.
* Collaborate with sales, credit, operations, and collections teams.

### **6. Tech & AI Enablement**

* Partner with tech teams to digitize and streamline processes.
* Leverage AI/ML for:
  + Lead scoring
  + Credit underwriting
  + Fraud detection
  + Customer segmentation
* Drive adoption of digital tools in field operations.

### **7. Stakeholder Management**

* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Credit, Risk, Ops, Tech, and Analytics.
* Align internal teams to deliver product outcomes.

**Key Requirements**
--------------------

### **Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in NBFC/Banking/Fintech.
* Significant exposure to LAP, MSME lending, or retail secured lending.
* Experience working in Tier 2/3/4 markets preferred.

### **Skills & Competencies**

* **Field Orientation:** Willingness to travel extensively and engage directly with customers.
* **Comfort with Ambiguity:** Ability to operate in evolving, unstructured environments.
* **Customer Insight:** Deep understanding of MSME and salaried segments in semi-urban/rural markets.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Ability to interpret financials, cash flows, and informal income patterns.
* **Product Mindset:** Strong problem-solving and innovation capabilities.
* **Tech Awareness:** Understanding of digital lending, AI/ML applications in financial services.
* **Execution Focus:** Ability to drive outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
* **Local Language:** Knowing any one or more of Tamil, Kannada and Telugu language is preferred.

### **Education**

* MBA/PGDM (preferred) or equivalent experience in financial services.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Regulatory Reporting Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

10

**The Team:**

Cappitech S&P is a leading provider of regulatory reporting and compliance solutions for financial institutions. Its platform automates trade and transaction reporting across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy and reducing operational risk. By streamlining complex regulatory processes, Cappitech S&P helps firms stay compliant and adapt quickly to evolving industry standards. The company’s innovative approach has significantly improved transparency and efficiency in financial markets.

**The Impact:**

As a member of Product team, you will play an important role in continuing to make it all happen. You will be joining a team of problem solvers and solution finders with a passion for providing the very best customer experience in a fast-paced environment. We are a diverse team supporting our global customers. S&P values focus on inclusiveness, collaboration and integrity and our management strive to provide a work environment that encourages our colleagues to achieve their full potential.

**What’s in it for you:**

As the Regulatory Reporting Product Manager, you will work within the Cappitech Product Regulation Team. You will have full ownership on the product life cycle (market analysis, concept, requirement definition through launch) while interacting with internal stakeholders to ensure the successful launch on new functionalities and continually improving the entire client experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Activities will include understanding regulatory requirements & translating those requirements into product features and system requirements, collaborating with the development teams and provide training and documentation internally to the Operational teams and externally to Customers.
* Gather and Analyze market requirements and offering
* Define Product requirements – from the high-level concept to detailed source mapping and functionality requirements
* Work with the Development and QA team to design and develop the solution to meet the business requirements
* Provide business, technical, and product knowledge in support of pre-sales activities in order to ensure customer satisfaction

**What We're looking for:**

Skill set and Knowledge:

Must have requirement

* Attention to detail
* Ability to read and understand regulatory documentation
* 6-8 years of experience in financial markets business or fintech
* Proactiveness in Identifying Risks, mitigating Risks and managing Project timeline.
* Previous hands-on experience in Derivatives regulatory reporting (JFSA, HKMA, EMIR Refit, ASIC, MAS, CFTC, SEC or Canada)
* A solid understanding of Derivatives Products such Swaps, Options & Forwards
* Building Requirement specifications and well versed with creating user stories in JIRAs
* Problem Solving Skills & Critical thinking abilities
* Building Requirement specifications and well versed with creating user stories in JIRAs
* Prior experience working with Development team
* Ability to reverse engineering
* Stakeholder management
* Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex or unfamiliar concepts in simple terms.
* Problem Solving Skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* SQL skills
* Able to work independently on multiple projects with minimal direction or supervision.
* Ability to work under pressure

**Good to have:**

* 4+ years in Product management

**About S&P Global Market Intelligence**  
  
At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction.
  
  
For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence .

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
Our benefits include:

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
* Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

**Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:**

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert:**

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here .

-

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

S&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment.

  

If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO.Compliance@spglobal.com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person.
  
  
**US Candidates Only:** Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager-Broking Business
job_description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Product Manager to lead the development and evolution of our broking business products. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of financial markets, broking operations, and product management best practices. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring our broking platforms and services meet market demands, regulatory requirements, and deliver exceptional user value. This role requires a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach, capable of collaborating with various cross-functional teams to drive product success.

* Define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our broking platforms and associated services, aligning with overall business objectives.
* Conduct thorough market research, competitive analysis, and gather customer insights to identify new opportunities and product enhancements.
* Translate business requirements and user needs into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize the product backlog, manage the product lifecycle from ideation to launch, and iterate based on performance and feedback.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, marketing, compliance, and legal teams throughout the product development process.
* Ensure all product features and functionalities adhere to relevant financial regulations and compliance standards (e.g., SEBI, exchanges).
* Monitor product performance using key metrics, analyze data, and provide actionable insights to drive continuous improvement and optimization.
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new product launches and feature releases, working with marketing and sales teams.
* Act as a subject matter expert on broking business processes, including trading, order management, account opening, settlement, and risk management.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation within the product team.

job_description:
If you are interested in working for us, please send your enquiry with a covering letter and CV to hr.brpl@rossari.com.

Thank you for your interest in our company.

  

**Position Title**: Product Manager

**Vertical/Division:** Chemical Division

**Location:** Kanjurmarg , Mumbai
  
  
**Job Type:** Full Time

**Responsibilities:**

* Drive product initiatives from concept through launch

* Develops marketing plans and market research.

* Owns revenue goals for his/her product line.

* Manages inventory, pricing, customer communications, and revenue forecasts.

* Manages worldwide supply, demand, revenue, margin, and pricing for product portfolio.

* Updates and presents forecasts regularly to management, finance, and manufacturing teams.

* Analyses market trends, customer requirements, and competitive strategy.

* Identifies opportunities for increasing customer and business value through product differentiation.

* Leads new product development process from concept through commercialization, including the voice of customer research, the definition of customer and product requirements and value proposition, managing product launches and sales training.

**Job Specification:**

* MBA with 3-5 years of relevant experience

* Ability to manage project scope, budget, and schedule to achieve timely completion of project deliverables

* Experience in managing multiple stakeholders and resolving conflicts within teams

* Excellent communication skills and effectiveness in marketing, product management, or strategy role including participating in market analysis, planning, and new product development

* Highly self-motivated with an ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects

**Title:** **Assistant Product Manager/ Product Manager - CNS**
===============================================================

Date: Nov 4, 2026

Location: Sun House - Corporate Office

Company: Sun Pharma Laboratories Ltd

**Job Title:**

Assistant Product Manager/ Product Manager (CNS)

**Business Unit:**

India Business

  

**Location :**

Mumbai

  
  
  

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

### **Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**

  

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

  

**Key responsibilities:**

* Development of marketing and promotional plans for products to support the end consumer’s need
* Monitor business performance and support the portfolio with the help of regular tracking
* Market intelligence through primary research and customer connect
* Writing and executing strategic business and marketing plans in collaboration with important prescribers, opinion leaders, round tables, and other advisory groups
* Joint financial responsibility for budgets (advertising and promotion, conferences and symposia, sales brochures and other product documentation, website content, literature), as well as analysis of budget income and costs;
* initiating and coordinating marketing activities and projects
* Presentation to staff and training field staff for the same
* Visiting national and international congresses, hospitals, and key opinion leaders (KOLs);
* Translating the corporate brand strategy in close collaboration with headquarters, together with logos and visuals, working with corporate product budgets (approval for expenditure on projects, local communication strategies), and providing input into corporate product strategy;
* Discussion partner for first, second, and third-line professionals such as general practitioners, medical specialists, pharmacists, and other medical professionals, and for other DMU members (decision-making units) such as local and national formulary committees and insurance companies;
* Organizing advisory councils, acting as a discussion leader or chairman, or giving product presentations.
* Collaboration with internal & external media to ensure the proper execution of strategies

  

**Travel Estimate**

Max. 1 week in a month

  

**Job Requirements**

  

**Educational Qualification**

B. Pharma + MBA - Marketing OR Pharma Management

  

**Experience**

2 to 3 years of experience in Pharma Marketing for Assistant Product Manager

3 to 4 years of experience in Pharma Marketing for Product Manager

  

**Therapy Exposure**

CNS therapy exposure is preferred however, open to other therapy experience

  

* Able to foster collaborative relationships
* Proven track record of launching and managing successful products
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in product management tools
* Good in communication and presentation
* Science driven marketing strategies

  

**Your Success Matters to Us**

  

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. *Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!*

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees as assigned to this job. Nothing herein shall preclude the employer from changing these duties from time to time and assigning comparable duties or other duties commensurate with the experience and background of incumbent(s).*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager Disruption Management
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**

  

This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

  

Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly **automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management** .

* Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

**Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise**

* Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
* Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
* Partner with adjacent product areas such as **DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions** .

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager, Growth
job_description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Role**

As Senior Product Manager, SaaS Growth, you will own product initiatives that improve customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion across Motive's Workforce Management suite of products. You will develop a deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and business opportunities, then translate those insights into a focused product strategy and roadmap. You will work closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer teams to deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.

This role is ideal for a product leader who combines strong customer empathy with analytical rigor, moves comfortably between strategy and execution, and thrives in a fast-growing environment. You will have the opportunity to shape growth experiences, test new ideas, and help scale products that serve the people who run physical operations.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Define and execute the Workforce product growth product strategy across acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion.
* Own the roadmap for growth initiatives by prioritizing opportunities based on customer needs, business impact, data, and technical feasibility.
* Lead customer discovery, market research, and competitive analysis to identify high-value growth opportunities.
* Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive product experiences through rapid, iterative experimentation.
* Establish success metrics, analyze product performance, and use insights to improve growth outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, including experience owning SaaS, growth, or commercially successful software products.
* Demonstrated ability to formulate, prioritize, and execute product roadmaps in partnership with engineering and design.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using qualitative and quantitative data to guide product decisions.
* Deep customer empathy and the ability to translate complex customer problems into simple, compelling product experiences.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams.

*Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.*

("Employer") discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.*

*Non-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.*

*All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager II
job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

title: Digital Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Syngenta is one of the world’s leading agriculture innovation company (Part of Syngenta Group) dedicated to improving global food security by enabling millions of farmers to make better use of available resources. Through world class science and innovative crop solutions, our **60,000** people in over **100** countries are working to transform how crops are grown. We are committed to rescuing land from degradation, enhancing biodiversity and revitalizing rural communities.

A diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace environment are enablers of our ambition to be the most collaborative and trusted team in agriculture. Our employees reflect the diversity of our customers, the markets where we operate and the communities which we serve. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet.

To learn more visit: www.syngenta.com

 **Job Description**

Role Purpose:

The Digital Product Manager AMEA is responsible and accountable for assigned digital products that support growers across Crop Protection and Seeds in AMEA.

The successful candidate will translate regional strategy and country business needs into a clear grower product vision, prioritized roadmap, and measurable delivery plan. Reporting to the AMEA Digital Strategy and Product management Lead, this person will connect commercial stakeholders, country teams, product squads, and global platform owners to implement solutions, drive adoption, and realize business value across AMEA markets.

Accountabilities:

1. Product Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership

* Own the vision, objectives, and end-to-end roadmap for assigned digital products, aligning grower and commercial needs with AMEA priorities and relevant global product strategies.
* Translate business opportunities into prioritized product requirements, user journeys, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through user research, process analysis, competitive review, and market assessment, with regular validation from growers, customers, and commercial teams.
* Manage the product lifecycle from ideation and business case through build, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Balance regional consistency with country-specific requirements, reusing scalable capabilities while addressing material market differences.

2. Commercial Partnership and Business Transformation

* Partner with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Commercial Operations, Crop Protection, and Seeds leaders to shape product priorities and support regional business transformation.
* Convert commercial processes and pain points into practical digital solutions that improve customer experience, execution quality, speed, and decision-making.
* Support country and regional product launches by coordinating process change, readiness, communication, training, and adoption activities.
* Act as the day-to-day product partner for business stakeholders, connecting long-term strategy with timely and pragmatic delivery decisions.

3. Business Case, Value Realisation and Adoption

* Develop and maintain business cases for new capabilities and major enhancements, defining expected value, investment needs, assumptions, risks, and success measures.
* Prioritize investments based on strategic fit, customer value, commercial impact, delivery feasibility, total cost, and reuse potential across markets.
* Own value-realisation plans and track product adoption, benefits, ROI, and operating performance with Finance, Commercial, and Analytics partners.
* Use performance data and customer feedback to identify adoption barriers, recommend corrective actions, and inform future roadmap decisions.

4. Stakeholder, Team and Delivery Leadership

* Build effective relationships with Country Digital Leads, Commercial Directors, functional leaders, global product owners, IT teams, vendors, and delivery partners.
* Lead or coordinate 2–3 Business Analysts or product team members as assigned, setting clear objectives, responsibilities, development priorities, and quality expectations.
* Facilitate alignment across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Agronomy, Data, IT, Legal, Privacy, and Security to resolve dependencies and unblock delivery.
* Guide agile or squad-based delivery by maintaining a clear backlog, making timely trade-offs, and ensuring acceptance criteria reflect business and user needs.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap, risks, decisions, and results to regional and country stakeholders using concise evidence-based narratives.

5. Governance, Platforms and Performance

* Define and monitor product KPIs covering customer experience, adoption, process performance, commercial value, reliability, and cost.
* Apply product governance, investment, architecture, data privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements throughout the lifecycle.
* Coordinate implementation and integration with relevant commercial platforms, which may include Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, DTP, Lynx, Cropwise, analytics, and content or commerce platforms.
* Maintain product health and delivery reporting, escalating material risks early and driving continuous improvement based on evidence.

Knowledge, Experience & Capabilities

Required Experience

* 12+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, commercial transformation, business analysis, or technology-enabled business change, with direct responsibility for product outcomes.
* Commercial domain experience in Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Commercial Operations, CRM, e-commerce, or related customer-facing processes.
* Experience delivering and scaling digital products across multiple markets in a matrixed, multinational organization.
* Demonstrated ability to create business cases, prioritize investments, track benefits, and communicate ROI and product performance to senior stakeholders.
* Practical experience with agile, product-led, or squad-based delivery and the management of roadmaps, backlogs, releases, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating small teams, Business Analysts, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Agriculture, Crop Protection, Seeds, FMCG, or another complex commercial sector experience is preferred; cross-cultural experience across AMEA is an advantage.

Knowledge

* Digital product lifecycle practices, including strategy, discovery, user-centred design, delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, iteration, and retirement.
* Commercial value chains and processes across marketing, pricing, sales, customer engagement, product launches, and commercial planning.
* Digital and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, DTP, Lynx, Cropwise, CRM, e-commerce, content, data, and analytics solutions.
* Business value measurement, including investment appraisal, benefits tracking, ROI, adoption metrics, and product performance reporting.
* Data privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, and responsible AI considerations affecting digital product deployment across multiple markets.

Capabilities

* Strategic and commercial thinking: Connects customer and business needs to product choices, while understanding value drivers, trade-offs, and market dynamics.
* Product judgement: Makes practical, timely decisions using evidence; balances user value, business impact, technical feasibility, cost, risk, and speed.
* Influence without authority: Builds alignment across regional, country, global, and cross-functional stakeholders through clear logic, data, and constructive challenge.
* Customer and grower empathy: Uses direct insight to understand needs, behaviours, and adoption barriers, and converts that understanding into product decisions.
* Delivery and people leadership: Creates clarity, holds teams accountable for outcomes, coaches others, and maintains momentum through ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Cross-cultural collaboration: Builds trust across diverse AMEA markets and adapts communication and delivery approaches without losing strategic consistency.

Critical Success Factors & Key Challenges

Critical Success Factors (24-month horizon)

* Assigned product roadmaps are aligned to AMEA and country commercial priorities, with transparent decisions, approved business cases, and clear ownership.
* Priority product launches or major enhancements are delivered with validated user and business value, appropriate quality, and effective market readiness.
* Adoption and value-realisation targets are agreed, measured, and actively managed, with evidence of improved customer experience or commercial process performance.
* Product governance and reporting provide stakeholders with reliable visibility of investment, delivery status, risks, adoption, benefits, and product health.
* Country teams, global platform owners, and product squads work to shared priorities with dependencies and decisions resolved in a timely manner.
* Business Analysts and product team members show measurable growth in product thinking, stakeholder engagement, analysis quality, and delivery discipline.

Key Challenges

* Balancing regional standardization and platform reuse with diverse country processes, customer needs, regulations, and levels of digital maturity.
* Prioritizing limited investment and delivery capacity across competing country, regional, functional, and global demands.
* Driving adoption and sustained behaviour change when the product depends on new commercial processes, data quality, local capability, or customer trust.
* Integrating global and regional platforms while managing legacy systems, technical dependencies, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory constraints.
* Maintaining delivery momentum and measurable value while requirements, market conditions, and stakeholder priorities evolve.

 **Qualifications**

Education B.tech/MBA,

12+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, commercial transformation, business analysis, or technology-enabled business change, with direct responsibility for product outcomes.

 **Additional Information**

Innovations

The employee may, as part of the role and through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions, contributing to inventions, designs, product work, know-how, copyrights, software, and other intellectual assets.

title: Senior Product Owner - Mendix
job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Owner - Mendix is responsible for defining product direction, driving functional and technical design, and ensuring the successful delivery and support of MES solutions for Mendix. The role translates business, operational, and manufacturing requirements into secure, compliant, and scalable solutions while managing product backlogs, priorities, and stakeholder expectations.

The role provides leadership across functional design, platform governance, CSV, solution architecture, and development oversight, ensuring solutions meet quality, security, data integrity, and GxP requirements. It collaborates with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, engineers, and strategic partners to drive standardization, reusable solutions, AI-enabled ways of working, and continuous improvement across MES products and platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, configure, develop, implement, and maintain Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions using Mendix, including domain models, entities, associations, and data management structures.
* Create and maintain microflows, nanoflows, and business logic to support business process requirements.
* Develop responsive pages, layouts, and widgets for web and mobile applications.
* Integrate Mendix applications with Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces, Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) services, databases, and enterprise systems.
* Configure and manage security settings, user roles, authentication, and authorization.
* Perform application testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization activities.
* Utilize Mendix Studio Pro, version control systems, and deployment pipelines to support the application lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, business users, project teams, and vendors to translate business requirements into Mendix solutions and deliver MES projects.
* Support application deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and upgrades across environments.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and support materials.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to team members.
* Use approved development and artificial intelligence-assisted tools in accordance with organizational standards and processes.
* Ensure compliance with Good Practice (GxP) requirements, data integrity, cybersecurity, and organizational standards.
* Contribute to standardization, established practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and application lifecycle management activities.
* Maintain knowledge of MES platforms, software technologies, and artificial intelligence tools to support solution development, maintenance, and delivery across multiple MES systems.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data Science, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with the Mendix Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform, including supporting solutions across multiple MES systems.
* Experience in database development using Microsoft SQL Server/Transact-SQL (T-SQL) and/or Oracle/Procedural Language SQL (PL/SQL).
* Experience in developing applications on the Mendix platform, including domain modelling, microflows, nanoflows, page development, security configuration, and application lifecycle management.
* Experience in system integrations, application programming interface (API) development, database management, and deployment of enterprise applications within the Mendix ecosystem.
* Experience in industrial system integration technologies, including Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA) and Open Platform Communications Historical Data Access (OPC HDA); experience with Component Object Model (COM) and Distributed Component Object Model (DCOM) is preferred.
* Experience in troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, software development, testing, technical documentation, version control, data integrity, and (GxP) requirements within regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience in using artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools for coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, and documentation, including validating AI-generated outputs in accordance with software quality, security, compliance, and maintainability requirements.
* Experience in using AI-assisted tools to draft requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and to summarize stakeholder input, with outputs reviewed prior to backlog inclusion.
* Experience in leading MES solution delivery across products, platforms, and sites.
* Experience in conducting technical reviews, troubleshooting issues, and performing root cause analysis.
* Experience in leading cross-functional teams and vendors in the delivery of Mendix solutions that meet business and compliance requirements.
* Experience in managing technical risks, data integrity, security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience in prioritizing backlogs, supporting technical decision-making, and contributing to Agile delivery practices.
* Experience in mentoring developers and contributing to established practices, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualification:**

  

* Relevant certifications in Artificial Intelligence (AI), cloud technologies, system integration, automation, data management, validation, cybersecurity, engineering, or related technical disciplines are preferred.
* Experience in applying problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills in software delivery environments.
* Experience in developing solution designs, managing technical documentation, and supporting compliant system delivery.
* Experience in system integrations, data management, security, quality management, and change control processes.
* Experience in collaborating with stakeholders, supporting team development, and contributing to standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

The role provides leadership across functional design, platform governance, CSV, solution architecture, and development oversight, ensuring solutions meet quality, security, data integrity, and GxP requirements. It collaborates with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, engineers, and strategic partners to drive standardization, reusable solutions, AI-enabled ways of working, and continuous improvement across MES products and platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, configure, develop, implement, and maintain Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions using Mendix, including domain models, entities, associations, and data management structures.
* Create and maintain microflows, nanoflows, and business logic to support business process requirements.
* Develop responsive pages, layouts, and widgets for web and mobile applications.
* Integrate Mendix applications with Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces, Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) services, databases, and enterprise systems.
* Configure and manage security settings, user roles, authentication, and authorization.
* Perform application testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization activities.
* Utilize Mendix Studio Pro, version control systems, and deployment pipelines to support the application lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, business users, project teams, and vendors to translate business requirements into Mendix solutions and deliver MES projects.
* Support application deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and upgrades across environments.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and support materials.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to team members.
* Use approved development and artificial intelligence-assisted tools in accordance with organizational standards and processes.
* Ensure compliance with Good Practice (GxP) requirements, data integrity, cybersecurity, and organizational standards.
* Contribute to standardization, established practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and application lifecycle management activities.
* Maintain knowledge of MES platforms, software technologies, and artificial intelligence tools to support solution development, maintenance, and delivery across multiple MES systems.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data Science, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with the Mendix Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform, including supporting solutions across multiple MES systems.
* Experience in database development using Microsoft SQL Server/Transact-SQL (T-SQL) and/or Oracle/Procedural Language SQL (PL/SQL).
* Experience in developing applications on the Mendix platform, including domain modelling, microflows, nanoflows, page development, security configuration, and application lifecycle management.
* Experience in system integrations, application programming interface (API) development, database management, and deployment of enterprise applications within the Mendix ecosystem.
* Experience in industrial system integration technologies, including Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA) and Open Platform Communications Historical Data Access (OPC HDA); experience with Component Object Model (COM) and Distributed Component Object Model (DCOM) is preferred.
* Experience in troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, software development, testing, technical documentation, version control, data integrity, and (GxP) requirements within regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience in using artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools for coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, and documentation, including validating AI-generated outputs in accordance with software quality, security, compliance, and maintainability requirements.
* Experience in using AI-assisted tools to draft requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and to summarize stakeholder input, with outputs reviewed prior to backlog inclusion.
* Experience in leading MES solution delivery across products, platforms, and sites.
* Experience in conducting technical reviews, troubleshooting issues, and performing root cause analysis.
* Experience in leading cross-functional teams and vendors in the delivery of Mendix solutions that meet business and compliance requirements.
* Experience in managing technical risks, data integrity, security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience in prioritizing backlogs, supporting technical decision-making, and contributing to Agile delivery practices.
* Experience in mentoring developers and contributing to established practices, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualification:**

  

* Relevant certifications in Artificial Intelligence (AI), cloud technologies, system integration, automation, data management, validation, cybersecurity, engineering, or related technical disciplines are preferred.
* Experience in applying problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills in software delivery environments.
* Experience in developing solution designs, managing technical documentation, and supporting compliant system delivery.
* Experience in system integrations, data management, security, quality management, and change control processes.
* Experience in collaborating with stakeholders, supporting team development, and contributing to standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

The Product Management (Technical) Expert is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the lifecycle of one or more products in Allstate's growing product portfolio. This individual manages strategic product vision, product discovery, roadmaps, and backlog to maximize the customer and enterprise value provided by their product. Successful Product Managers help to identify assumptions and validate those assumptions using product discovery techniques. This individual is also responsible for working closely with key stakeholders and partners, ensuring the successful definition and execution of go-to market and communications strategies for their products.

**Primary Skills:** Confluent Kafka, Event Streaming, Product Management, Cloud Platforms, Data Integration

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking an experienced **Digital Product Manager** to lead the strategy, roadmap, governance, and adoption of our enterprise **Confluent Kafka Event Streaming Platform**. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of product management expertise, event-driven architecture knowledge, platform governance experience, and stakeholder management capabilities.

This role will be responsible for defining the vision and roadmap for the enterprise streaming platform, enabling business teams to build real-time data products, driving platform modernization initiatives, and ensuring the platform delivers secure, scalable, and reliable streaming capabilities across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own and define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the enterprise Confluent Kafka platform.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, data platform teams, and security organizations to prioritize platform capabilities and enhancements.
* Drive adoption of event-driven architecture and streaming technologies across the enterprise.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritization, feature planning, and release management activities.
* Establish governance standards for topic management, schema evolution, data retention, security, and platform onboarding.
* Lead platform modernization initiatives involving cloud-native streaming, real-time analytics, AI/ML integration, and data sharing capabilities.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve platform scalability, resiliency, observability, performance, and self-service capabilities.
* Define and track key product metrics including platform adoption, producer/consumer growth, throughput, platform health, and customer satisfaction.
* Work with business and technology leadership to identify opportunities for real-time event streaming solutions.
* Manage vendor relationships and evaluate emerging event streaming technologies and capabilities.
* Drive platform operational excellence through continuous improvement initiatives and customer feedback programs.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 12+ years of experience in Product Management, Data Platforms, Middleware, Integration Technologies, or Event Streaming solutions.
* Strong experience with **Confluent Kafka** and enterprise event streaming platforms.
* Proven experience managing platform products and driving enterprise-wide technology adoption.
* Deep understanding of event-driven architecture, publish-subscribe patterns, stream processing, and real-time data integration.
* Experience working with Agile product management frameworks and roadmap planning.
* Strong understanding of Kafka ecosystem components including:
  + Kafka Brokers
  + Kafka Connect
  + Schema Registry
  + Control Center
  + ksqlDB
  + Stream Processing
* Experience defining platform governance, security, compliance, and operational standards.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with observability platforms including Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Experience presenting product strategy and roadmap to executive leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with **Confluent Cloud** and hybrid cloud streaming architectures.
* Knowledge of data engineering, lakehouse platforms, real-time analytics, and data mesh concepts.
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, and event-driven AI architectures.
* Experience integrating Kafka with API gateways such as Apigee, Kong, or other integration platforms.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, OpenShift, container platforms, and cloud-native technologies.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and DevSecOps practices.
* Confluent certifications or Product Management certifications are highly desirable.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**
----------------------------

* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to balance business priorities and technical requirements.
* Experience leading large-scale platform transformation programs.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Increased adoption of enterprise event streaming capabilities.
* Growth in Kafka producers, consumers, and business use cases onboarded.
* Improved platform reliability, security, scalability, and customer experience.
* Reduction in onboarding time through self-service and automation capabilities.
* Successful delivery of strategic roadmap initiatives aligned with business outcomes.
* Enhanced real-time data enablement across the enterprise.

### **Ideal Candidate Profile**

A senior product leader with deep expertise in **Confluent Kafka and Event Streaming Platforms**, capable of defining product strategy, influencing enterprise architecture decisions, and driving adoption of real-time data capabilities that accelerate digital transformation across the organization.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Yateesh B Gybgaa@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.
