title: Senior Product Manager - Fully Remote Job
job_description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

**Farnell**

Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair.

**Role** Assistant Product Manager

**Business Function** Product

**Reports to** Senior APM

**3** Customer Service - Accountable for responding to customer tickets and technical queries, including liaising with suppliers in multiple time-zones to resolve issues in a timely manner.

**6** Marketing co-ordination – work with the Strategic Sourcing Group (SSG) and suppliers to provide content for agreed marketing activities.

**7** Quality – responsible for implementation process in line with the Quality Management System with exceptional levels of detail and accuracy in product content and presentation.

Essential

* Exceptional focus on customer service, quality and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills
* Comfortable speaking with multiple global stakeholders
* Experience in managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines/SLA commitments
* Excel and IT skills
* Ability to work autonomously & drive results
* Strong quantitative and data management skills

Desirable

* Experience succeeding in a Global Matrix organization
* Experience working in a customer service environment
* Technical aptitude
* Experience of working within a quality assured environment.

UK shift - 1PM to 10 PM

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Overview:** Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India’s no. 1 RPM Company.

We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare - enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models.

As our Senior Product Manager, you will be part of Dozee’s Product – Product Management team, owning  
Product Strategy & Vision, User Research & Problem Discovery and Product Execution & Delivery. It is a  
high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and  
who wants to help save lives with Health AI.

### **Responsibilities**

* Independently own product strategy for assigned products or modules, translating customer insights and business objectives into actionable roadmaps.
* Independently lead customer discovery, validate hypotheses, identify unmet needs, and converts insights into prioritised product opportunities.
* Manage end-to-end product releases, oversee dependencies, risks, timelines, and ensure successful product launches and iterations.
* Make product decisions using quantitative metrics, experimentation, customer behaviour, and business performance insights.
* Balance customer needs, technical constraints, and commercial priorities while solving complex product challenges and identifying new opportunities.
* Manage prioritisation across multiple product initiatives, balancing customer needs, engineering capacity, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure compliance to and own the design and development SOPs.
* Ensure highest quality standards and seamless customer experience.

### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of relevant experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline
* Anticipate customer challenges, identify unmet needs, and consistently advocates for customer value in product decisions.
* Navigate competing stakeholder priorities, facilitate complex discussions, and build alignment around product decisions.
* Independently evaluate complex product challenges, assess trade-offs, and make decisions balancing customer, technical, and business considerations.
* Demonstrate end-to-end accountability for product outcomes, release quality, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of product objectives.
* Mentor junior product team members, drive collaborative execution, and promote continuous learning and improvement within the product team.

### **Role Expectations**

* Lead complex deliverables or projects end-to-end and set the quality bar for the area.
* Translate team goals into clear plans and drive cross-functional collaboration.
* Mentor junior colleagues and share knowledge across the team.
* Use data to track progress and improve outcomes.
* Uphold Dozee’s values and quality-first culture in every deliverable.

**Vision & Mission**

**Save Million lives with Health AI**

Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered **contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)** and **Early Warning System (EWS).** A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A **"Made in India for the World"** solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.

Dozee is adopted by **300+ hospitals** and **monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries**. Dozee has monitored over **1 Mn Patients,** Delivered **35000+ Life Saving Alerts** and Saved **10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.**

**Videos**

* Science Behind Dozee : Ballistocardiography & Artificial Intelligence

- 100 Dozee deliver 144 life saving alerts and INR 2.7 Cr of saving - Sattva Study

* Dozee saves life of a mother at home

* Leading Healthcare Game changers work with DozeeI

* Introducing Dozee VS

- Dozee Shravan - A clinical grade RPM service

**Dozee in News:**

**Bloomberg - Oct 21, 2024**

From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps

**News18Oct 26, 2024**

Now, You Can Remotely Monitor Your Loved Ones in Hospital With Bengaluru Start-Up's 'Shravan'

**Analytics India MagazineOct 29, 2024**

Dozee Harness AI for Personalised Patient Care

**ET HealthWorldSep 16, 2024**

We trust AI everyday - From Google Maps to Smartphones, So why not use it to enhance patient safety in healthcare?

**BW healthcareworldOct 29, 2024**

Dozee's AI-Powered System Predicts Patient Deterioration 16 Hours in Advance

A tertiary care hospital study published in **JMIR**, validated Dozee’s Early Warning System (EWS), showing it **identified 97% of deteriorating patients, provided alerts ~19 hours in advance**, and generated **5x fewer alerts,** reducing alarm fatigue and improving patient outcomes.

A study at King George Medical University, Lucknow, and published in **Frontiers in Medical Technology** demonstrated that Dozee’s automation can potentially save **2.5 hours of nursing time per shift**, improving workflow efficiency and allowing more focus on patient care.

A study on remote patient monitoring in general wards published in **Cureus** found that **90%+ of healthcare providers reported improved care** and patient safety, **74% of patients felt safer**, and there was a **43% increase in time for direct patient care.**

Research by **Sattva**, an independent consulting firm, demonstrates Dozee's substantial impact: for every 100 Dozee-connected beds, it can **save approximately 144 lives**, **reduce nurses’ time for vital checks by 80%**, and **decrease ICU average length of stay by 1.3 days.**

**Key Highlights**

* **Founded :** October, 2015

* **Founders :** Mudit Dandwate, Gaurav Parchani

* **Headquarters :** Bangalore, India | Houston, USA | Dubai, UAE

* **Key Investors & Backers :** Prime Ventures, 3one4 Capital, YourNest Capital, Gokul Rajaram, BIRAC (Department of Biotechnology, State Bank of India, and Dinesh Mody Ventures, Temasek Foundation, Horizons Ventures

* **Stage :** Series A+

* **Team Strength :** 280+

* **Business :** Providing Continuum of care with AI-powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS) for Hospitals and Home.

* **Certifications & Accreditations :** ISO13485:2016 Certified, ISO27001:2022 Certified, CDSCO Registered, FDA510K Cleared for the flagship product Dozee Vitals Signs (VS) measurement system and SOC2 Type II Certified

**Achievements:**

* Forbes India 30 under 30

* Forbes Asia 100 to Watch

- Times Network - India Health Awards 2024 for AI innovation in Bharat Healthcare tech

* BML Munjal Award for Business Excellence using Learning and Development

* FICCI Digital Innovation in Healthcare Award

* Anjani Mashelkar Inclusive Innovation Award Marico Innovation For India Award.

***To know more about life@dozee,*** ***click here******.***

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.” Dozee does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Dozee will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager - Conversations
job_description:
**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.  
  
**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  
  
**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts  
  
**About the Team**  
Conversations is HighLevel's unified inbox. It brings SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram DMs, TikTok, live chat and calls into one thread per contact, and connects to other CRM products, AI Employee, Reporting and Payments. Agencies use it to manage communication on behalf of their SMB clients, so every improvement we ship compounds across thousands of sub-accounts. As part of the team, you will improve existing inbox capabilities, conceptualize new AI-native features, and deliver solutions that drive improvements to time to value, adoption, engagement and retention.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to join the Conversations team. This role is for self-driven individuals who are passionate about communication products and SaaS. You will independently own a product area within Conversations, from customer calls to post-launch growth, and drive results using data, customer insights and AI-enabled ways of working.  
  
**Your Responsibilities**  
You will own a defined area of the Conversations product end to end across discovery, delivery, launch and growth. This includes identifying the highest-impact customer problems, validating solutions before build, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ship improvements that move activation, adoption, engagement and retention.

* Set the strategy, roadmap and priorities for your area within the portfolio direction, and own its outcomes.
* Lead 4–6 agency calls a week to uncover the real problems behind feature requests.
* Turn calls, support tickets and feedback into sized insights, jobs to be done and pain points.
* Map each pain point to an existing, extended or new capability, and frame testable hypotheses.
* Build hi-fi prototypes and validate them with internal stakeholders and customers before engineering starts.
* Define requirements, write clear PRDs and ship with engineering and design in weeks, not quarters.
* Define the GTM motion and launch artifacts with Marketing, Support and Customer Success, and run betas and staged rollouts.
* Instrument features before launch, track usage, and run experiments to improve activation, adoption, engagement and retention.
* Prepare data and narratives for WBRs, QBRs and annual planning.
* Partner with cross-functional teams on shared surfaces and dependencies.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of junior PMs where needed.

**Your Core Skills**
--------------------

* Strong communicator who runs customer calls with confidence and empathy.
* Clear, concise writer whose PRDs and updates stand on their own.
* Strong analytical mindset to structure qualitative feedback into themes and quantify impact.
* Strong product sense, with the ability to deconstruct complex software experiences and highlight good UX from bad UX.
* Self-driven owner of a feature set, who plans and executes independently, with rigour on scoping, trade-offs and follow-through.
* Artifact-driven, producing clear artifacts at every stage of the product lifecycle.
* AI-enabled, using AI tools daily for synthesis, analysis, PRDs and prototyping.
* AI-native, designing and shipping AI features such as suggested replies, summaries, routing and agents.
* A problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

**Experience**
--------------

* 7-9 years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Experience on a communication or messaging product: inbox, helpdesk, CPaaS or CRM messaging
* Proven track record of shipping customer-facing features that moved activation, adoption, engagement or retention
* Experience building for agencies or multi-tenant, white-label platforms
* Experience preparing data and narratives for business reviews or annual planning

**Deep Understanding of**
-------------------------

* Messaging channels and their rules: A2P 10DLC, WhatsApp Business Platform, email deliverability and consent
* Competing inboxes such as HubSpot, Intercom, Front, and Zendesk
* Product funnels: activation, adoption, engagement, retention and time to value
* Running discovery and validation loops with prototypes and beta users
* AI feature design, including how to measure quality, trust and adoption
* Working with engineering on APIs, webhooks and event pipelines
* Writing clear, structured PRDs and communicating roadmap trade-offs to stakeholders
* Analyzing data from tools like Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel or Superset to inform product decisions

**EEO Statement**  
The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Turn calls, support tickets and feedback into sized insights, jobs to be done and pain points.
* Map each pain point to an existing, extended or new capability, and frame testable hypotheses.
* Build hi-fi prototypes and validate them with internal stakeholders and customers before engineering starts.
* Define requirements, write clear PRDs and ship with engineering and design in weeks, not quarters.
* Define the GTM motion and launch artifacts with Marketing, Support and Customer Success, and run betas and staged rollouts.
* Instrument features before launch, track usage, and run experiments to improve activation, adoption, engagement and retention.
* Prepare data and narratives for WBRs, QBRs and annual planning.
* Partner with cross-functional teams on shared surfaces and dependencies.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of junior PMs where needed.

**Your Core Skills**
--------------------

* Strong communicator who runs customer calls with confidence and empathy.
* Clear, concise writer whose PRDs and updates stand on their own.
* Strong analytical mindset to structure qualitative feedback into themes and quantify impact.
* Strong product sense, with the ability to deconstruct complex software experiences and highlight good UX from bad UX.
* Self-driven owner of a feature set, who plans and executes independently, with rigour on scoping, trade-offs and follow-through.
* Artifact-driven, producing clear artifacts at every stage of the product lifecycle.
* AI-enabled, using AI tools daily for synthesis, analysis, PRDs and prototyping.
* AI-native, designing and shipping AI features such as suggested replies, summaries, routing and agents.
* A problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

**Experience**
--------------

* 7-9 years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Experience on a communication or messaging product: inbox, helpdesk, CPaaS or CRM messaging
* Proven track record of shipping customer-facing features that moved activation, adoption, engagement or retention
* Experience building for agencies or multi-tenant, white-label platforms
* Experience preparing data and narratives for business reviews or annual planning

**Deep Understanding of**
-------------------------

* Messaging channels and their rules: A2P 10DLC, WhatsApp Business Platform, email deliverability and consent
* Competing inboxes such as HubSpot, Intercom, Front, and Zendesk
* Product funnels: activation, adoption, engagement, retention and time to value
* Running discovery and validation loops with prototypes and beta users
* AI feature design, including how to measure quality, trust and adoption
* Working with engineering on APIs, webhooks and event pipelines
* Writing clear, structured PRDs and communicating roadmap trade-offs to stakeholders
* Analyzing data from tools like Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel or Superset to inform product decisions

### **Senior Product Manager – AppsForBharat**

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bangalore
  
**Role Type:** Full-time

**Role Overview - Senior Product Manager**

As Senior Product Manager for Sri Mandir Web, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for building a fast, engaging, and trustworthy website that serves millions of devotees worldwide. This is a first-principles, high-ownership role, you will be expected to question existing assumptions, reimagine devotee journeys for the web (a fundamentally different medium from app), and build measurable, compounding growth loops around acquisition, engagement, and monetisation.

You will be especially responsible for how devotees are acquired, including through SEO. Reimagine how devotees experience the site pre and post-transaction in their journeys and turn a one-time visitor into a returning, engaged devotee.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

***Product Vision & Strategy***

* Define and own the Sri Mandir Web Product roadmap, grounded in first-principles thinking that works for Web audience.

* Identify the highest-leverage problems in the devotee journey by breaking them down to root causes, not surface symptoms.

* Work with Website P&L lead, to own the complete business flywheel and deliver retention and revenue outcomes

***Acquisition & Organic Growth***

* Own complete acquisition funnels with a strong focus on organic and SEO-driven growth alongside paid and referral channels.

* Partner closely with Analytics, CRM, Content, Marketing, Design and Engineering teams to define the site architecture that drives speed and enable discoverability at scale.

***Engagement & User-First Journeys***

* Apply deep, empathetic, user-first thinking to design web journeys that feel intuitive, trustworthy, and delightful for devotees

* Design and continuously refine post-transaction user flows, cross-sell and re-engagement journeys, that build habitual, repeat engagement

***Data-Driven Decision Making***

* Leverage analytics, cohort analysis, user research, and market insights to identify problems, size opportunities, and prioritise the roadmap.

* Set up and track KPIs across the funnel, traffic, conversion, ARPU, retention, and repeat transactions

***Ownership & Cross-Functional Leadership***

* Lead the product lifecycle from concept and requirements to launch and post-launch optimisation.

* Stay ahead of web/SEO trends, competitor moves, and emerging technologies to keep Sri Mandir Web at the frontier of devotional tech.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelors or Masters degree from Tier 1 premier institute — IIT, BITS Pilani, IIM, ISB preferred.

* Experience: Minimum 4+ years of B2C product management and growth experience, with measurable impact on Revenue, CRO LTV and Retention

* First-principles thinker: Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, complex problems from the ground up rather than relying on existing playbooks.

* Web acquisition & SEO: Product knowledge of SEO and organic acquisition levers (technical SEO, content strategy, site performance)

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex, funnel-level datasets.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Past founding or entrepreneurial experience.

* Hands-on experience with SEO/organic growth as a primary growth lever in a previous role.

* Experience managing products across Web platforms.

* Past experience building and growing e-commerce products.

Let’s build something meaningful together. ✨

job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise data platform capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions that support business, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Gather customer and stakeholder feedback to identify platform enhancements, emerging needs, and innovation opportunities.
* Create and manage product backlogs, requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive adoption of modern data engineering practices and cloud-native platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with data scientists, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure data platforms support AI and machine learning workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform product strategy and investment decisions & Define measurable business outcomes and monitor product performance against established objectives.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership & Support planning, prioritization, and execution of platform modernization initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in in Product Management, Technology, Data Platforms, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and modern platform architectures & Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale technology or data platform products.
* Experience working with large-scale data processing, data integration, analytics, or data platform solutions.
* Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or similar distributed processing frameworks.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms, data lakes, metadata management, or data governance solutions.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts and AI-enabled business capabilities & Experience supporting products, platforms, or solutions used for analytics, machine learning, or generative AI workloads.
* Ability to define product requirements that enable AI-ready data assets, model development, or data-driven decision makin & Familiarity with modern AI ecosystem concepts such as MLOps, feature engineering, model lifecycle management, or AI governance.
* Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI-enabled capabilities & Knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or related AI technologies.

  
  
  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

The CCB Data & Analytics team responsibly leverages data across Chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers. The team encompasses a variety of disciplines from data governance and strategy to reporting, data science and machine learning. We have a strong partnership with Technology, which provides cutting edge data and analytics infrastructure. The team powers Chase with insights to create the best customer and business outcomes.

title: Sr Product Manager - Marketplace
job_description:
**About us:**  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is  
important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  
  
**Team overview:**  
Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy & Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.  
  
We are seeking a **Sr** **Product Manager – Seller Tools & Engagement** to define and execute the strategy for how Target+ engages, guides, and enables sellers at scale.  
You will lead the strategy, vision, and execution of our Seller Portal. You will shape the ecosystem that empowers sellers, expands guest choice, and delivers scalable growth  
In this role, you will lead a charter that improves seller activation, compliance, performance, and adoption across the marketplace lifecycle. You will own the systems, signals, and experiences that shape seller behavior—driving measurable improvements in marketplace quality, operational efficiency, and seller success.  
  
This is a highly cross-functional, data-driven role requiring strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to influence outcomes without authority. You will partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and analytics teams to deliver intelligent, scalable solutions that help sellers take the right actions at the right time.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will take lead on - Owning seller lifecycle engagement, including activation, adoption, performance improvement, and re-engagement. Designing data-driven nudges, reminders, and interventions that influence seller behavior and improve compliance, quality, and productivity. Enabling sellers to easily understand what actions they need to take and why, reducing friction and support dependency. Driving measurable behavior change in seller success. Define KPIs for marketplace success Use data and experimentation (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to refine features and improve adoption. Drive AI/ML powered insights

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* **6+ years of hands-on Product Management experience** or equivalent domain experience
* Proven success in **building and scaling marketplaces, platforms, or complex multi-sided ecosystem**
* Deep understanding of marketplace economics, seller ecosystems, and buyer behavior.
* Strong technical aptitude, experience working closely with business, engineering and data science and cross functional enterprise teams.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to think strategically while driving operational excellence.

**Useful Links**:

* Life at Target- https://india.target.com/
* Benefits- https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* Culture- https://india.target.com/life-at-target/diversity-and-inclusion

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - AI / ML
job_description:
Product Manager – Data, Analytics & AI/ML

**Experience:** 9–12 Years  
**Open Positions:** 2  
**Locations:** Hyderabad | Pune | Bengaluru  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid (8 days per month from office)  
**Compensation:** Up to ₹35 LPA Fixed + Variable (Maximum CTC: ₹38 LPA)

Role Overview

We are looking for experienced Product Managers to drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise data, analytics, and AI/ML platforms. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in product/program management, enterprise-scale technology initiatives, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise data, analytics, and AI platforms.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, data science, and architecture teams to identify and prioritize high-impact use cases.
* Lead cross-functional teams across data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, security, and business functions.
* Drive end-to-end execution of product initiatives, ensuring timely delivery within scope, quality, and budget.
* Manage dependencies, risks, and issue resolution across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, and compliance frameworks.
* Drive adoption of enterprise data platforms, analytics solutions, and AI/ML capabilities.
* Define and track product KPIs, including adoption, usage, performance, data quality, and business value realization.
* Manage senior stakeholder engagement and executive communication.
* Drive change management, onboarding, training, and rollout strategies.
* Optimize platform cost, performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Drive license governance, usage monitoring, cost management, and ROI realization.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 9–12 years of experience in Product Management, Program Management, or Delivery Leadership.
* Strong experience in one or more of the following domains:
* Data Engineering
* Enterprise Analytics Platforms
* AI/ML Solutions
* Advanced Analytics
* Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional, enterprise-scale programs.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture and architecture governance/review processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.

Interview Process

* AI Interview
* Technical/Leadership Panel Interview
* Final Panel Interview

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and preferred location.**

Pay: ₹2,565,000.00 - ₹3,040,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Years of experience in Product Management / Program Management / Delivery Leadership?
* Years of experience in Data Engineering / Analytics / AI/ML platforms?
* CTC
* ECTC
* How soon Can you join?
* Can you join Immediately?
* Are you comfortable with hybrid work (8 days per month from office)?
* Reason for change

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout
job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

The Checkout Experience team owns one of the most important moments in the buyer journey: helping customers complete their purchase with confidence, speed, and clarity. The space includes guest and member checkout, express payment experiences, checkout success, and key dependencies across cart, payments, shipping, and post-purchase experiences.

  
  

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead complex, high-impact checkout initiatives that reduce friction, improve buyer trust, and unlock conversion at scale. In this role, you will define and drive multiple initiatives across the checkout funnel, influence cross-functional roadmaps, and help shape the future of Checkout Experience.

  
  

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* Lead multiple Checkout Experience initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the biggest sources of buyer friction and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Partner across Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, and adjacent product teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Drive improvements across areas such as guest checkout, member checkout, express payments, delivery clarity, payment optimization, incentives, and checkout success.
* Use analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to make decisions and refine the roadmap.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and align teams around tradeoffs, sequencing, and success metrics.
* Contribute to the longer-term vision for checkout, including personalization, modernized flows, and AI-assisted experiences.
  

  

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Experience owning multiple customer-facing products or features end to end in a consumer, ecommerce, marketplace, or payments environment.
* 8+ years of relevant experience
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and priorities.
* Comfort using data, experimentation, and customer insights to size opportunities and guide decisions.
* Ability to write clear product requirements with strong hypotheses, success metrics, and execution plans.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Domain depth, or quickly demonstrated depth, in checkout, payments, buyer experience, ecommerce, or conversion optimization.
* A bias toward action, strong prioritization instincts, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
job_description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
* Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
* Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
* Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
* Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

**About the team**
------------------

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

  
Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

title: Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI
job_description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Job Description
  
Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI)
  
At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have or obtain work authorization in the country where the position is to be considered. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.
  
  
Path/Level
  
P3
  
Job Title
  
Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI
  
Job Function
  
Information Technology
  
Location
  
India – Bangalore
  
Reports to
  
Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly
  
  
**Note:** Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making.
  
This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value.
  
The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product vision, strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy.
* Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies.
* Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development.

Product discovery and data-product definition
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions.
* Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback.
* Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect.
* Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures.

End-to-end product delivery and acceptance
  
  

* Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking.
* Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs.
* Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release.
* Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption.
* Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations.
* Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions.

Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership
  
  

* Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders.
* Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required.
* Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity.
* Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development.
* Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change.
* Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions.

Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship
  
  

* Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams.
* Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures.
* Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities.
* Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value.
* Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products.

Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management
  
  

* Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures.
* Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products.
* Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities.

Role Accountability and Decision Rights
  
  
The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
Required
  
  

* Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe.
* Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar.
* Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results.
* Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs.
* Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management.
* Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority.

Preferred
  
  

* Pharma, life sciences or healthcare Commercial experience across brand, sales operations, market access, marketing analytics or omnichannel engagement.
* Experience with AI/ML or generative-AI product use cases such as next-best action, forecasting, recommendation or copilots for Sales users.
* Experience handing data products over to downstream analytics, reporting or decision-support platforms.
* Familiarity with tools and services such as Confluence, Databricks, AWS, Power BI, Tableau, Redshift or Amazon S3.
* One of the Product, Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP would be advantage.

Leadership Behaviors
  
  

* Creates urgency and momentum while making thoughtful product trade-offs.
* Influences without authority across multiple levels and functions.
* Communicates clearly, listens actively and builds trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Works constructively through ambiguity and keeps teams focused on outcomes and decisions.
* Uses analytical and critical thinking to identify product, data and delivery gaps.
* Balances customer advocacy with enterprise reuse, governance, quality and long-term product sustainability.

When applying internally for a position, your current supervisor receives notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.

If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
