job_description:
**About the Team:**

Global Supply Chain is at the heart of GSK, manufacturing and supplying reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to patients around the world while driving our performance as a business. This team oversees the end-to-end supply network — from product, portfolio and network strategy through to operational delivery and distribution — ensuring that we meet patient needs efficiently, safely and sustainably across all our markets.

Supply Chain and Strategy within Global Supply Chain brings together planning, customer supply chain, external manufacturing, classic and established products, and other specialist teams into one connected organisation with full visibility across the supply chain. By joining this team, you’ll help build a world-class, data-driven and resilient supply chain ready for the future, combining science, technology and talent to make sure GSK’s products reach the people who need them, wherever they are.

**Job Purpose:**

* The Senior Product Owner (ePI) is responsible for maximising the value of Electronic Product Information by translating regulatory and operational business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across a complex product ecosystem. The role ensures that regulatory- and process-driven changes are delivered within applicable GxP, compliance, data-use and data-access requirements and within strategic and financial guardrails agreed with the Product Manager in line with Tech leadership direction. Working closely with business stakeholders and external partners, the Product Owner defines outcomes and ensures delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.
* The Senior Product Owner (ePI) guides Product Analysts and works with Engineers, Architects, Testers, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.
* The role is accountable for maintaining clarity of scope and decision making throughout discovery, refinement, design, testing, release and operation. Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs that exceed delegated authority are escalated to the Product Manager, who coordinates further escalation to the Product Domain Lead or Tech leadership team in line with agreed decision rights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes and maintain alignment throughout delivery.
* Lead end-to-end product delivery across the complex ePI ecosystem, guiding Product Analysts and coordinating Engineers, Architects, Testers, enterprise platform teams and external partners to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to applicable standards.
* Ensure ePI product changes, including regulatory-driven changes, comply with applicable GxP, security, data-use, data-access, privacy, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls, obtaining specialist approvals where required.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring epics, features and user stories are well defined and supported by relevant data on value, users, cost, risk, dependencies and process impact.
* Use AI tools to draft requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and summaries of stakeholder input, and have the output reviewed before it enters the backlog.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.
* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions and maintain clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change.
* Drive operational readiness using a structured checklist covering support model, training, continuity, configuration, runbooks, release notes, validation evidence and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, process outcomes, cycle time, stability, defects, user experience and support effort.
* Support Architects in assessing design options and manage cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing.
* Build working knowledge of the ePI platforms and, with guidance, identify straightforward improvement opportunities, such as regulatory-change automation, and flag them to the Product Manager for assessment.
* Act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues and guide resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and use feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education & Professional Qualifications:**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership and product lifecycle management
* Requirements, backlog and acceptance management
* Agile and iterative delivery
* User-centred design and adoption
* Product performance, operational readiness and continuous improvement
* Enterprise technology, data, integration, security and service principles
* Understanding of regulated manufacturing, supply chain, quality or laboratory environments
* The role requires sufficient technical, analytical and business understanding to translate operational needs into controlled product changes. The education or equivalent experience enables the job holder to evaluate value, feasibility, process impact, data, risk, security, compliance and support implications and to communicate clearly with business and technology specialists.

**Job-Related Experience:**

* Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required
* Typically 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, refinement or drafting, with human review of outputs before they enter the backlog.
* Experience managing digital products within a complex ecosystem of business functions, regulatory stakeholders, enterprise platforms and external partners, ideally involving Electronic Product Information or comparable regulatory-driven solutions.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience guiding Product Analysts, Engineers, Architects and Testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience applying GxP, security, data protection, data-use and data-access restrictions, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls in a regulated environment.
* Experience defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

**Preferred:**

* Product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications are desirable.

**Skills**

Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

* Understanding of regulated manufacturing, supply chain, quality or laboratory environments
* The role requires sufficient technical, analytical and business understanding to translate operational needs into controlled product changes. The education or equivalent experience enables the job holder to evaluate value, feasibility, process impact, data, risk, security, compliance and support implications and to communicate clearly with business and technology specialists.

**Job-Related Experience:**

* Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required
* Typically 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, refinement or drafting, with human review of outputs before they enter the backlog.
* Experience managing digital products within a complex ecosystem of business functions, regulatory stakeholders, enterprise platforms and external partners, ideally involving Electronic Product Information or comparable regulatory-driven solutions.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience guiding Product Analysts, Engineers, Architects and Testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience applying GxP, security, data protection, data-use and data-access restrictions, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls in a regulated environment.
* Experience defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

**Preferred:**

* Product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications are desirable.

**Skills**

Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications

job_description:
***Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.***

  

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers*.* Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

  

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

  

**About the opportunity:**

When a traveler's bag goes missing or a trip is cancelled, what happens next runs on our operations: claims, policy changes, refunds, documents and service requests. We're moving that work onto one enterprise case management and BPM platform, used by up to 2,000 people across North America and Australia–New Zealand first, then Europe.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own it. You'll decide which processes move first, lead our BPM analysts in the US and India, and work with our implementation partner to deliver workflows that cut handling time and manual effort.

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the case management and BPM vision, roadmap and backlog across claims, servicing and operations
* Rank processes by value: volume, handling time, errors, customer impact and regulation
* Design processes once and configure them by region, brand and partner
* Apply a clear automation order: API first, RPA where there's no API, people where judgment matters
* Bring in AI where it pays: document intake, triage, next-best action and handler summaries
* Give handlers one workspace for cases, documents and customer context
* Lead the BPM analyst team and set standards for process design and requirements
* Act as Product Owner with our SI partner: epics, acceptance criteria, sprint reviews and sign-off
* Plan rollout, training and adoption with operations leaders in each region
  

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* 10+ years in product management, operations transformation or BPM
* 5+ years owning a case management or BPM platform such as Pega, Appian, Camunda or ServiceNow
* A track record of automation that measurably cut handling time or cost
* Experience rolling out a shared platform across regions or business units
* Strong process design skills: BPMN, Lean, SLAs and work allocation
* Experience leading analysts and managing SI partners and vendors
* The credibility to bring operations and technology leaders to one plan

**Nice to have**

* Insurance claims, policy servicing or assistance operations experience
* Migration from legacy claims or case systems
* AI in operations: document intake, triage or agent assist
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* BPM platform or Scrum Product Owner certification
  

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

  

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

  

**Job flexibility**. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.

  

**Career growth**. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

  

**Take the time you need, for you and your community**. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

  

**Diversity and inclusion**. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**

* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.
  

***Appy today and let’s go to great places together!***

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - KYC Platform
job_description:
Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
  
**Drive governance:** own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.
  
  
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  
**Platform product experience:** 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
  
**Regulated entity experience:** hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
  
**Technical depth:** you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
  
**Data-driven mindset:** you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
  
**Partner management:** you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
  
**Long-term systems thinking:** you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
  
**Communication:** you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.
  
  
GOOD TO HAVE
  
  
Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
  
**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
  
**Drive governance:** own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.
  
  
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  
**Platform product experience:** 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
  
**Regulated entity experience:** hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
  
**Technical depth:** you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
  
**Data-driven mindset:** you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
  
**Partner management:** you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
  
**Long-term systems thinking:** you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
  
**Communication:** you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.
  
  
GOOD TO HAVE
  
  
Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
  
**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

Job Description

**JD: Associate Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) | Small Hybrid Vertical**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Department:** Product Management

**Location:** Navi Mumbai

**Reports To:** Senior Product Manager

  
  

### **About Us**

At **ideaForge Technology**, we are pioneering the future of autonomous flight. We design, manufacture, and deploy cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) that solve complex challenges across industries—from defence, homeland security and infrastructure inspection to emergency response and delivery.

  
  

### **Role Summary**

As an Assistant Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) for the Small Hybrid Verticals portfolio within the Switch UAV family, you will own the product lifecycle, strategy, and market performance for this critical product line. You will report to the Senior Product Manager and operate as a leader within the product management function, bridging customer demand (defense, paramilitary, state agencies) with engineering capability, manufacturing constraints, and regulatory certification requirements.

This role blends strategic product development with hands-on execution across requirements, regulatory alignment (DGCA, FCC, BlueUAS Certification), business planning, and cross-functional team leadership. You will drive the product roadmap from market research through production at scale, managing trade-offs between performance, cost, compliance, and customer needs.

  
  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  
  

### **Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Develop and execute the multi-year product roadmap for Small Hybrid Verticals. Define product variants, performance tiers, and feature evolution across the Switch family. Work with engineering leadership to balance feature requests, technical feasibility, development timelines, and manufacturing capacity.

* Drive business cases for new initiatives (new variants, payload integrations, airframe configurations). Forecast revenue, unit economics, and market penetration for roadmap milestones.

### **Customer & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct ongoing market research across Indian defense buyers (Army Aviation, BRO, state police, paramilitary forces) and international defense bodies. Translate customer pain points and operational requirements into product requirements documents (PRDs).

* Lead competitive analysis of global and domestic UAV platforms operating in similar tactical niches. Track competitor capabilities, pricing, go-to-market strategies, and certifications.

* Support sales and business development teams with tender responses, feature positioning documents, and pricing justification. Participate in customer demonstrations and technical discussions to validate requirements.

### **Regulatory Certification & Compliance Leadership**

* Own the regulatory certification pathway for Small Hybrid Verticals through DGCA Type Certification and international regulatory bodies (FAA, EASA, etc.). Coordinate with certification teams, external agencies, and technology partners.

* Ensure product design, documentation, and testing align with aviation regulations. Prepare certification-readiness reports and mitigate compliance risks early in the development cycle.

* Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

### **Cross-Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

* Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

* Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

### **Cost, Pricing & Business Performance**

* Conduct cost-of-goods analysis for Small Hybrid Verticals. Build bottom-up cost stacks including BOM, labor, overhead, and manufacturing yield. Identify cost-reduction opportunities across design, sourcing, and manufacturing.

* Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

* Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

### **Go-to-Market & Launch Strategy**

* Develop go-to-market plans for new variants or airframe configurations. Define launch messaging, positioning, channel strategy, and customer communication.

* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success to prepare launch materials, data sheets, video content, and training documentation.

* Support contract negotiations and tender responses by providing technical specifications, performance claims, and regulatory compliance documentation.

  
  
  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor''s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.

* 3–5 years of product management, program management, or systems engineering experience in hardware-software integrated products (UAVs, aerospace, robotics, automotive, or defense systems).

* Demonstrated experience managing product lifecycle from concept through production, including involvement in design, testing, and field deployment.

* Strong technical aptitude. Ability to understand complex hardware and software architectures, flight dynamics, payload integration, and avionics. Comfortable reading design documentation, block diagrams, and engineering specifications.

* Excellent cross-functional communication skills. Proven ability to align engineering, manufacturing, sales, and leadership around product priorities.

* Analytical and data-driven mindset. Comfortable with financial modeling, cost analysis, and business case development.

* Familiarity with regulatory and certification frameworks (DGCA, FAA, EASA, or similar) and willingness to deepen expertise in aviation regulations.

* Strong organizational and project management skills. Track record of driving initiatives to completion in cross-functional environments.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience with UAV, drone, or autonomous systems design and development.

* Familiarity with Indian defense procurement processes, MoD acquisition cycles, and government buyer workflows.

* Experience working in defense, aerospace, or highly regulated hardware sectors.

* Knowledge of avionics, flight control systems, power systems, or payload integration challenges.

* Exposure to Agile or lean product development methodologies.

* Experience with manufacturing, supply chain, or cost optimization initiatives.

Skills

Product Management

Collaboration Building

Program Management

Analytic Problem Solving

Customer Interaction

Regulatory Knowledge

Systems Engineering Process

Data Analytics

Continuously develop knowledge throughout all stages of the product lifecycle while contributing to an effective and mature product management practice.

* 6–10 years of overall professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field within a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Verified expertise in directing the product lifecycle and developing the roadmap.

* Experience working with product, engineering, and business collaborators.

* Strong collaborator management, communication, facilitation, influencing, and negotiation skills.

* Bachelor's Degree or comparable experience.
* 6–10 years of overall professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field within a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Verified expertise in directing the product lifecycle and developing the roadmap.

* Experience working with product, engineering, and business collaborators.
* Experience leading multiple workloads and challenging priorities.
* Strong collaborator management, communication, facilitation, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to bring to bear data and insights to drive business and product decisions.

* Experience supporting benefits administration, Group Products, or related retirement-processing operations, particularly the administration of lump-sum and annuity benefits for traditional pension plans and Pension Risk Transfer arrangements.
* Working experience in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments.
* Practical experience working with Jira, Confluence, and Miro or similar tools.
* Exposure to end users, business collaborators, and technology teams.
* Understanding of Distribution in Life/Group Insurance would be a plus.

--------------

* Product Discovery & Experimentation
* Product Lifecycle Oversight
* Agile Delivery
* Collaborator Management
* Business Insight
* Prioritization & Decision Making
* Communication & Facilitation
* Influencing & Negotiation

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, AI
job_description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

### **What you'll do:**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Why Work for Us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
